description: Маршрутен график – разписание на автобусните линии от общинската, областна и републиканска транспортна схеми is a dataset listed in Open Data Bulgaria, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Лиляна Пенчева. Route schedule, timetable of bus lines from municipal, regional and republican transport schemes. Coverage: Лиляна Пенчева. The portal shows the English title as "Route schedule — timetable of bus lines from municipal, regional and republican transport schemes" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Лиляна Пенчева. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-bulgaria.
